offering_description.value: Makes and sells packaged meats, prepared foods, nuts and nut butters for grocery retailers and foodservice operators. It processes and packages foods for retail shelves and commercial kitchens, selling through retail accounts and foodservice distributors.

primary_products.value: bacon and deli meats; refrigerated meals and entrées; canned meats and chili; turkey products; nuts and nut butters

customer_segment.value: B2B: Grocery and mass-market retailers, foodservice distributors, restaurant chains and institutional kitchens; B2C: Households buying packaged foods through retailers; B2G: Public school meal programs buying through foodservice channels

end_markets.value: consumer packaged foods; restaurants; institutional foodservice

revenue_model.value: product sales: Retail-packaged foods and bulk or portioned foods for commercial kitchens

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Processes meat, nuts and other ingredients into packaged foods for retailers and foodservice buyers

geography_served.value: global: Primarily the United States, with sales in Canada, Asia and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: Packaged meats, prepared meals, nuts and nut butters share retail and foodservice channels

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Grocery, mass-market retail and restaurant chain accounts; distributors / dealers: Broadline and specialty foodservice distributors; third-party retail: Supermarkets, warehouse clubs, mass merchants and convenience stores; online: Retailer websites and online grocery platforms
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; distributors / dealers; third-party retail; online

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: USDA meat and poultry inspection and FDA food safety and labeling requirements for other packaged foods
